thesis: The episode argues that primary care must evolve from a reactive model focused on diagnosing illness to a proactive system centered on continuous health monitoring and risk stratification. It posits that the future of primary care requires an automated data collection layer to efficiently triage patients, ensuring that scarce doctor time is reserved for those requiring intervention while leveraging support staff and community health workers to manage low-acuity needs.
